current_grouping: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines
versions.text: The fuel system shall be constructed and arranged in a manner to assure the provision of fuel to each engine at a flow rate and pressure adequate for proper engine functioning under all normal conditions of operation, including all maneuvers and acrobatics for which the airplane is intended.
